questions.q: Why generate the model card from the registry and run data instead of typing it?
options: The registry writes the limitations section for you
Model cards are required by Azure to deploy
It makes the model more accurate
The numbers are read from the source of truth, so the card cannot drift from what was actually trained
questions.explain: Pulling the run name, metrics and parameters from MLflow means the card matches the registered version exactly, instead of relying on memory.

questions.q: At a 0.5 threshold, which contract segment had the lowest recall in the segment check, and why?
options: Two-year contracts, because churn is rarer there and few scores cross 0.5
Month-to-month, because it had the fewest customers
One-year, because AUC was highest there
All segments were identical
questions.explain: Two-year customers had recall 0.147. Their churn rate is only about 14%, and the model flags about 4% of them at 0.5, so most churners are missed.

questions.q: What happened when a per-segment threshold equal to each segment's churn rate was tried?
options: Both recall and precision improved in every segment
Nothing changed
Recall rose but precision fell, a trade-off rather than a free fix
The model stopped scoring
questions.explain: Recall rose to about 0.67, 0.73 and 0.77 but precision dropped, so more calls would be wasted. The threshold should come from validation data and calling capacity.

questions.q: A day after you delete your endpoints and clusters, what does the wrap-up recommend checking?
options: The model registry version number
Cost analysis in the Azure portal, to confirm spend has stopped
The PSI chart
The GitHub star count
questions.explain: Endpoints keep compute allocated while they exist. Checking cost analysis a day later confirms nothing is still billing.

questions.q: How should you talk about cloud steps you could not actually run when presenting the project?
options: Say plainly what was illustrative and that you reviewed it against the official docs
Say you deployed it to production
Leave them out of the write-up
Show screenshots from a different project as your own
questions.explain: Being upfront about what was synthetic or illustrative earns more trust than pretending. Never present work you did not do as your own.
